summary: Jodit Editor vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting
details: Description — замени целиком на: Jodit Editor is a WYSIWYG editor written in pure TypeScript without the use of additional libraries. Versions before 3.18.2 are vulnerable to XSS attacks when pasting specially constructed input: HTML copied from a page controlled by an attacker could carry an event handler (for example ``) through the paste-from-Word path into the editor. The published proof of concept no longer executes from jodit 3.18.2. Jodit 4 rewrote the HTML sanitiser (`clean-html` / `safeHTML`), and 4.12.31 closed the remaining `javascript:` URL scheme normalisation gap (CVE-2026-62324, GHSA-j839-gqq4-gf9j). The sanitiser is covered by a regression suite that pins the published payloads. Workaround for 3.x: sanitise pasted HTML on the server, or upgrade to a current 4.x release.
